text:
I've read the whole codebase (10 source files, 4 test files, config, build scripts, and the committed demo outputs). Here's my honest assessment.

## Overall impression

The code itself is well-written: clean module separation, type hints throughout, `yaml.safe_load`, no shell/network/injection surface, idiomatic numpy, tidy CLI. If you only read the source top to bottom it looks like a 7–8/10 project. The problem is that it doesn't run, and the part that "works" is partly validating itself.

## The big findings

**1. The pipeline cannot run — the dataset is missing and there's no generator (high).**
`run_extract` (emovec/extract.py:26-27) immediately calls `load_story_manifest`/`load_stories` (emovec/data.py:24-45), which require `data/stories/manifest.json` and per-emotion story files like `data/stories/happy/00_0.txt`. There is no `data/` directory anywhere in the repo, and no code anywhere that generates stories — despite the README saying "Load or generate labeled short stories." That means `make demo`, all three documented CLI commands, and the end-to-end test (`tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12`) all fail with `FileNotFoundError` out of the box. The committed `outputs/tiny_demo/` artifacts — whose manifest embeds a 20-topic story manifest that must have existed at generation time — are the only evidence the pipeline ever ran. The data was generated somewhere and never committed.

**2. The tiny-mode "validation" is rigged (medium).**
The tiny backend injects 2.0× the ground-truth emotion vector when given the story's label (emovec/model.py:147-148, fed from emovec/extract.py:32), and its `EMOTION_LEXICON` (emovec/data.py:15-32) is transparently reverse-engineered from the validation `SCENARIOS` — "afraid" keys on "dark", "trail", "snapping"; "frustrated" on "fifth", "will not". So `diagonal_gt_off_diagonal: true` is guaranteed by construction, and the integration test asserts this rigged metric as if it validated the method. A deterministic demo backend is fine; a test suite that asserts the rig as a success criterion is misleading.

**3. Assorted real but smaller defects.** Full list below — the notable ones are a silent fallback in the dosage probe that writes "afraid"-labeled artifacts for a different emotion, a good/bad logit measurement that only uses first subtokens and doesn't match its own prompt, and dead config keys that are silently ignored.

## Issue list

| # | File:lines | Sev | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | emovec/extract.py:26-27 (+ emovec/data.py:24-45, config.yaml:8) | high | Required `data/stories/` dataset is absent and no generation code exists; extract, demo, and docs commands all crash with FileNotFoundError |
| 2 | tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12 | high | End-to-end test depends on the missing dataset, so the advertised test suite is red on a fresh checkout |
| 3 | README.md:11, 54-66 | medium | README claims stories are "load[ed] or generate[d]" and presents `make demo` as runnable; neither is true and setup never explains how to obtain the data |
| 4 | emovec/model.py:144-153, emovec/data.py:15-32 | medium | Tiny backend injects ground-truth label vectors and uses a lexicon copied from the validation scenarios, making the context validation tautological |
| 5 | emovec/validate_contexts.py:66 | medium | If "afraid" isn't in the emotion set it silently uses emotion index 0 but still writes `afraid_dosage.*`, producing mislabeled artifacts |
| 6 | emovec/model.py:306-308 | medium | HF preference logit compares only the first subtoken of " good"/" bad", and the prompt asks for "a preference score" — measurement doesn't match prompt and is tokenizer-fragile |
| 7 | emovec/model.py:234-240 | low | `prompt.find()` returning -1 is unhandled, and the no-offset fallback silently steers every token, changing experiment semantics on slow tokenizers |
| 8 | emovec/model.py:243-250 | low | No truncation/max-length on inputs (OOM risk on long stories); one full forward pass per scenario via `final_activation` is wasteful |
| 9 | emovec/vector_ops.py:31 | low | `pca_components_for_variance` always returns ≥1 component even at threshold 0.0 |
| 10 | emovec/extract.py:34-36 | low | Effective-start logic duplicates `layer_position_mean`; the manifest's recorded range can silently diverge from what was actually averaged |
| 11 | emovec/steer_prefs.py:45-49 | low | Falling short of 4 emotions discards the positive/negative selection wholesale for `emotions[:4]`; config's `min_reported_emotions` is never read |
| 12 | emovec/config.py:42-54, config.yaml:10,50 | low | Dead/unvalidated config keys (`neutral_corpus`, `min_reported_emotions`); missing sections default to empty emotions and fail later with cryptic `np.stack` errors |
| 13 | emovec/model.py:7 | low | Unused `Iterable` import |
| 14 | outputs/tiny_demo/** | low | Committed generated artifacts that can no longer be reproduced from the repo |

Security-wise there's nothing alarming: config is `yaml.safe_load`, there's no subprocess/network/eval, and the shell script is quoted and `set -euo pipefail`. The risks here are correctness and reproducibility, not security.

## Rewrite estimate

The codebase is ~1,000 lines of Python. Most of it is fine as-is. What needs real work: a story dataset module or generator (new code, ~100-150 lines), honest tiny-mode test assertions, the dosage-probe fallback, the HF logit/tokenization fragility, and config cleanup — roughly **150 lines** changed or added across existing files, plus the new data-provisioning code.

## Bottom line

**No, I would not approve this as-is.** Not because the code is sloppy — it isn't — but because the repository's primary function is unrunnable (missing dataset, no generator), the test suite fails on checkout, and the one passing "validation" is asserting an outcome the demo backend was built to produce. Fix data provisioning and the test honesty, and this becomes an approvable, genuinely decent small research codebase.
